//: AeroWars configuration. Lines with the '//' key are comments and are ignored.

General.//: Language file to use from the lang/ folder (en_us, pt_br, ...).
General.//LobbyWorld: World players are returned to when a match ends or they leave.
General.//LobbySpawn: Optional 'x,y,z,yaw,pitch' lobby spawn; empty = world default spawn.
General.//Prefix: Chat prefix for plugin messages (branding). PrefixEnabled=false removes it entirely; edit Prefix to rebrand. Supports {#RRGGBB} color tags.

Setup.//SpawnWand: Item given to the admin during setup: left-click (block OR air) marks the spawn at your position, right-click removes the spawn in front of you. Detection is via the discrete interaction watcher, so use a weapon-style item (the bundled AeroWars_SetupWand maps both clicks to a discrete interaction); a plain block/furniture item won't register the right-click. Locked in the inventory until you finish.

Match.//: Global match tuning. Per-arena min/max players come from the arena's spawn count.
Match.//EndCelebrationSeconds: Celebration/finalization time after a match ends, before the room closes. Victory fireworks keep launching for this whole window.
Match.//SpectateOnDeath: Dead players become spectators instead of being removed.
Match.//SaveInventory: On joining a match: saves the player's inventory + gamemode and clears them; on leaving/ending, restores them. Players enter in Adventure mode.
Match.//RandomizeSpawns: Randomize which island (spawn point) each player/team starts on. When false, teams fill the islands in order (1, 2, 3, ...); when true, the island each team gets is shuffled per match.
Match.//AnnounceWinner: Tell everyone on the server who isn't in the match who won it and on which arena. The text is 'match.win_announce_solo' / 'match.win_announce_team' in the language files, so it follows General.Language.

Cages.//: Cages hold players on their island during the countdown. Cages are now PREFABS in the cages/ folder (one .prefab.json each, captured with Hytale's prefab tool). The built-ins are generated on first run; author more and pick per player (cage cosmetics) or per arena (/aerowars arena cage).
Cages.//FallImmunitySeconds: Seconds of fall-damage immunity for everyone from match start (when the cages drop), so a high cage drop can't hurt players on landing. Only fall damage is waived; 0 disables it.
Cages.//Orientation: Per-cage rotation and face-the-middle live on each cage's entry in cosmetics.json (the 'rotation' degrees + 'faceMiddle' flag), so a cage's whole definition stays in one place.

Loot.//: Chest loot. Loot tables are defined in loot.json in the plugin data folder.
Loot.//FillOnStart: Fill every chest once when the match starts (the initial loot; not an 'event').

Events.//: Unified in-match events. Each entry has a Type and a Time (seconds since the match started). Type 'refill' re-rolls every chest; 'loot_upgrade' upgrades a growing share of common chests to MIDDLE loot and refills. Add/remove entries freely.
Events.//Randomize: When true, each event's Time is IGNORED and the enabled events fire at random moments, in random order, spread across the match — always inside the match duration and never closer than MinGapSeconds (so nothing fires too fast). When false, events fire at their Time.

Kits.//SelectionDuringCountdown: Let players open the kit menu while waiting/counting down.
Kits.//PersistLastKit: Remember each player's last-selected kit across matches (they keep it until they pick another). Off = every match starts on DefaultKit until selected.
Kits.//WaitingItems: Give waiting players (in their cage) a locked hotbar: a kit-selector item (opens the kit menu) and a return-to-lobby item. Non-droppable; removed when the match starts.
Kits.//HotbarItems: The bundled AeroWars_* items are weapon-style so BOTH left- and right-click reliably open/leave. If you swap these for another item id, use a weapon-category item (Categories: Items.Weapons + Interactions Primary/Secondary) with its own Icon — a plain block/furniture item only registers left-click and may show no hotbar icon.

Rewards.//WinnerCommands: Extra commands run on a solo win. {player} = winner name, {arena} = arena; supports 'broadcast <message>'. Empty by default — the winner announcement itself is Match.AnnounceWinner, which is translated. Example: ["broadcast &6{player} won on {arena}!"]
Rewards.//Economy: Pays coins on kill/win via an installed economy plugin (overworld economy, EliteEssentials, Ecotale). No-op if none is present.

//Effects: Victory fireworks show and the winner's podium during the end celebration.

Effects.//FireworkParticles: Native Hytale firework particle systems, one picked at random per burst.
Effects.//PodiumEnabled: Raise the winner(s) onto a block podium above the arena centre during the celebration.

Party.//KeepTogetherByDefault: Default of a party's 'keep together' preference (leaders toggle it in the party menu). ON = only join matches where the whole party fits one team, never split (leader is told if no arena fits); OFF = an oversized party is split, overflow members randomly moved to other teams.

//Platform: Spawn platform built into a freshly created void template world (/aerowars world create). Size is clamped odd; keep <= 15 so it stays inside the preloaded spawn chunk.
//Spectator: Hypixel-style spectator hotbar given on death: a living-player tracker (opens a teleport modal) and a return-to-lobby item. Slots are 0-8; items are locked in place and removed when leaving.

Spectator.//NativeMode: Run spectators on Hytale's native spectator mode (0.6+): the engine makes them fly, pass through blocks, take no damage and stay hidden from living players and the player list (spectators still see each other and share the spectator voice channel). Set false for AeroWars' own flight + invulnerability + hiding (no passing through blocks).
Spectator.//Items: See Kits.//HotbarItems: the bundled AeroWars_* items are weapon-style so both clicks work. If you swap these, prefer a weapon-category item with its own Icon. Spectator tools have an extra raw-mouse fallback, so a non-weapon item still works in open air but may not register a block-aimed right-click.

//Database: Optional SQL persistence for stats/leaderboards (HikariCP, like Plots). Driver chosen by JdbcUrl (sqlite/mysql/mariadb/postgres). Drivers are NOT bundled — drop HikariCP + the JDBC driver on the server classpath; otherwise it falls back to stats.json. A bare 'jdbc:sqlite:aerowars.db' resolves under the plugin data dir.
